title: The Weeknd Drops Lush Travelogue Video For ‘Hong Kong’: Watch
summary: Abel sings karaoke and broods his way through the city in the clip featuring Cantopop legend Faye Wong and starring Chinese supermodel Ming Xi.
body: The Weeknd dropped the brooding video for his recent one-off single, “Hong Kong,” on Thursday (Nov. 12). The lush travelogue-style trip through the daytime hustle and nighttime rush of the island is enhanced in the Evan Larsen-directed clip by guest vocals from Cantopop legend Faye Wong and a co-starring role from Chinese supermodel Ming Xi. title: Amazon cuts $105 off Sony ULT WEAR headphones
summary: The headphones are 42% off on Amazon, with bass-boost sound, active noise canceling, and travel-ready folding design.
body: Big bass and a quieter trip can make a huge difference on a commute, flight, or study session, and there’s a good Amazon deal on a pair built for exactly that. The Sony ULT WEAR headphones are down to $144.95 in Black, which is a strong option for anyone who wants over-ear wireless headphones with extra low-end punch and noise canceling without paying flagship prices.
